trace_ledger.prerequisites: Essence Catalyst built for Study; element unlocked and required level for a spell
trace_ledger.expenditure: Assigned researcher time; casting fuel separately checked
trace_ledger.mutation: Element experience and levels; learned-spell event text
trace_ledger.time: Experience accumulates per tick; cooldown is checked at cast time
trace_ledger.failure: Unmet knowledge or live cast gates block the action
trace_ledger.aftermath: New spell option becomes visible; no mana is granted by learning

trace_ledger.prerequisites: Visible and enabled Fireball with Fire level 6
trace_ledger.mutation: Cast effect, mana subtraction, use experience, last-cast time
trace_ledger.failure: Unaffordable normal cast exits before effect, cost, or experience
trace_ledger.aftermath: Current mana and storage capacity still constrain repeated casting

trace_ledger.prerequisites: Exploration unlocked; Water level 14; recipe resources and items
trace_ledger.expenditure: 400 mana, 5000 Water Essence, 65 Water shards before transformations
trace_ledger.consumer: EquippableItem stat effects and tagged Action effect transformation
trace_ledger.time: No time gate established by selected trace
trace_ledger.failure: Recipe or visibility gates block crafting; unequipped wand does not apply its registered Water multiplier

trace_ledger.prerequisites: Wizards unlock after Transmutation and 500 capped Coins; assigned wizards/rules
trace_ledger.expenditure: Autocast points for ordinary casts; permacast may drain mana each tick while charging
trace_ledger.mutation: Rule points, spell effects, mana and disabled status
trace_ledger.consumer: Autocast tick listeners and strategy loader
trace_ledger.time: Points accrue per tick; second listener resumes after income when starved
trace_ledger.failure: Ordinary rule skips failed gates; check-only can stop later rules; permacast may spend mana without effect

trace_ledger.prerequisites: Posterity event after primary-element maximum for run reaches level 7; Continue option
trace_ledger.expenditure: Retirement replaces run state; selected trace establishes no item/currency entry fee

read_scope: Five connected traces and immediate registration/consumer paths, not the full recovered map or all privately decoded files. Vendor map was acquired and indexed but has no cited gameplay body.
open_edges: No runtime/browser play of the demo
No retail or DLC binary/source audit
No save migration or actual YAIR implementation
Map symbol presence alone does not establish demo reachability
